name: Burger King
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Burger King in Tirol!**

Discover the perfect mix of global fast food and Alpine charm in the heart of the **Tirol**. Whether you're craving a classic **Whopper**, a juicy **Bacon King**, or a delicious **Chicken Sandwich**, our menu has something for everyone.

After your meal, explore the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**—from the breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps** to the vibrant city life of **Innsbruck**. Don’t miss out on trying local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** or **Tiroler Gröstl** at nearby restaurants.

Visit us at our locations in **Innsbruck**, **Kufstein**, or **Lienz** and enjoy your favorite **Burger King** experience with a side of **Tirol** adventure!
